methodology.recommendation_coverage: Eligible recommendations with at least one enrichment destination.
methodology.service_slot_coverage: Covered destination slots divided by all expected category/service combinations.
methodology.exact_or_resolved: A direct publisher/service item URL already present in the source or verified by a catalog resolver.
methodology.search_fallback: A service search URL generated from the extracted title and creator; useful but not an exact item match.

exact_item_mapping_coverage.note: Search fallbacks are excluded from every metric in this section.
